item.title: Cursed Tiles Now Show When They Expire: Reading Tal the Cursed's Board After 1.5.4b
item.description:
MID GAME

A curse that looks permanent gets played around forever. That was the actual problem behind two 1.5.x fixes, and it changed boss decisions without changing a single boss rule.

1.5.4b: Tile Expiration did not visually update cursed tiles when they expired. 1.5.6 added a second fix: no error when a cursed tile’s piece disappears before the curse triggers.

THE ONE-SCREEN ANSWER

The countdown was real, the display was not keeping up. After 1.5.4b an expired cursed square clears visually, so you can plan around when it ends instead of treating the whole board as permanently cursed. Watch one expiry in your own run before trusting an old guide that says curses never lift.

item.title: Quick Restart No Longer Wipes Gambit Medal Progress After 1.5.4b
item.description:
MID GAME

Losing progress is the one bug that changes how people play. If a restart looks like it wipes your medal, you stop restarting, and that is a much bigger cost than the medal itself.

1.5.4b lists it under fixes, not changes. Fixed an issue where Gambit Medal progress would reset after using Quick Restart. The progress was always supposed to stay.

item.title: Tooth's Gambit Finally Pays When You Sell It: Rebuilding the Sell-for-Gold Loop
item.description:
MID GAME

If you sold Tooth’s Gambit in September and the balance did not move, you did not misclick. The 1.5.4b notes list it plainly: fixed an issue where Tooth’s Gambit wouldn’t give money when selling it.

Selling a Gambit is two decisions at once. It frees one of your five slots and it should return money. Before 1.5.4b, one specific Gambit gave you the slot and kept the money.

item.title: Six Gambit Bugs Fixed in 1.5.4b: A Check-Your-Client Checklist
item.description:
MID GAME

Some bugs cost you a run. Others quietly cost you a Gambit slot. The 1.5.4b fixes are mostly the second kind, which is exactly why players kept misreading them as balance changes for a month.

Six fixes shipped on 30 September 2026. Two were visual or platform issues, four were state bugs that made a Gambit or a progress counter behave as if it were broken, because it was.
